kind: offline, CPU, existing logs only; confirmation of a post hoc choice on episodes not used in stallu_20261119
user_decision: 2026-11-19: user approved step 1 (new prereg, realization ratio + linear-scale Otsu, offline check on other episodes).
change_from_stallu: Only the threshold scale. stallu used rule() (eta-picked scale) -> log 0.0079, NOT_ADOPTED. Here the scale is fixed to linear because rho is a bounded ratio. This choice was made AFTER seeing stallu (post hoc FPR-matched 0.16 was equivalent to 3 mm; linear Otsu 0.205 / 0.204 was seen as a number but never evaluated on any mode test).

definition.rho: as stallu_20261119: c_t = 0.01*action_exec[t,:3], r_t = ee_pos[t]-ee_pos[t-1], pi_t = r_t.c_t/|c_t|, rho = sum_24 pi / sum_24 |c|
definition.threshold: linear-scale Otsu (scale_rule_20261117 otsu() on min(x, 99th percentile), 256 bins) on all pre-success steps of the dev logs unify0_20261116 NORULE (3 seeds) -> one number, used unchanged everywhere

confirmation_sets.C1: usb_keyed_s13p_role_2x2_20261108 + usb_keyed_s13s_seed_rep_20261108, no selector: FIRST0 (corrector off) vs FIRSTR (on), tags p / 20261029 / 20261030, 600 episodes each (same as resoff_test_20261117 primary)
confirmation_sets.C2: same studies, Q selector: Q0 (off) vs QR (on), tags 20261029 / 20261030, 400 each
confirmation_sets.C3: belief_parts_20261116 BLOCK (full Q + blocking rule, corrector on), seeds 20260921-23, 600 episodes
confirmation_sets.not_for_verdict: Q400B / Q400B0 (used in stallu) at the same threshold, reported only

mode_test: as resoff_test_20261117 / stallu: window = steps 24..min(first success, first 90 deg rotation); first flagged step; positive = flip; TPR, FPR, AUROC (earliness score)

predictions.V1: linear Otsu refitted on the pre-success steps of FIRSTR, QR and BLOCK is each within +-30% of the dev threshold
predictions.V2: in each of FIRSTR, QR, BLOCK: AUROC >= AUROC_OLD - 0.02, FPR <= FPR_OLD + 0.03, TPR >= TPR_OLD - 0.05
predictions.V3: FPR_off - FPR_on >= 0.30 in both C1 and C2
predictions.V4: in each of FIRSTR, QR, BLOCK, flip episodes flagged by both: median (first_new - first_OLD) <= +12 steps and 90th percentile <= +36

verdict.PASS: V1-V4 all true -> candidate for the closed-loop 3-seed check (user approval, new prereg)

expectation: about 50%. Main risk: 0.205 is looser than the FPR-matched 0.16, so FPR may exceed OLD + 0.03 (V2).
also_reported_exploratory: Q400B / Q400B0 at the same threshold
nonflip episodes: share flagged by new only / OLD only
